name: New Generation Academy — club recruitment
rationale: This deployment is a recruitment drive at New Generation Academy, which is not yet one of the 180 schools on the official PLP form. Running the baseline survey with the school and year levels fixed to that school lets PLP gather accurate numbers before the school is added to the official form.

schools.reason: Single-school recruitment drive. Everyone answering is at New Generation Academy, so the 180-school dropdown is replaced by that one value and filled in automatically.

yearLevels.reason: New Generation Academy uses Grade 7 to Grade 10, plus Year 1 and Year 2, rather than the S1-S6 levels on the official form.

questions.reason: The club writes its own application questions in the admin dashboard. None of the baseline instrument's 28 questions are asked here — the admin's own first question already collects the applicant's name and class, and the school is fixed for this rollout. The source questions are WITHHELD, not deleted: they stay in data/survey-source.json, still verified, and the full form returns by clearing this list.

framing.reason: Students at New Generation Academy are applying to join PLP Ishami using PLP's own Membership Application & Family Questionnaire, not filling in the termly baseline survey. This changes only the wrapper language — headings, button labels, the word used for a submission — never a question, an option, the form title or the confirmation message.

labels.headline: PLP Ishami — Membership Application & Family Questionnaire
labels.lede: “We learn together. We grow together. We look out for each other.” Tell us who you are, why you want to join, and what you will bring to the family.
labels.successBody: We will reply to the email address you gave us. There is nothing else to do for now.
labels.confirmation: Thank you for applying. Please wait for further response — you will be given an answer before the start of 7 January 2027.

note: data/survey-source.json remains the untouched, verified extract of the original Google Form. Everything above is a documented deviation for THIS deployment only. `npm run verify:survey` checks the source is still intact AND lists these deviations, so nothing here is silent. To return to the official form, delete the entries under "overrides".
